initial_state.padding: P=UInt32(ceil(Rout/Rin)*2048) in the default child mode +a=0
initial_state.childBuffers: Float32 input atchild+38; output atchild+40. The output allocation is explicitly cleared before initial P frames become visible to wrapper bookkeeping. Do not replace this artificial padding with an unproven soxr_delay result.
initial_state.capacity: Native output capacity is ceil(FMA(Double(inputCapacity),ratio,Double(P))+1024); relevant original operations100315180..19c. Preserve rounding and checked bounds.

positive_block: drift=RN64(RN64(cumulativeIdeal+ideal)-Double(cumulativeVisibleOutput+base)). requested=base+(drift>1 ?1:0); requested==0 becomes1. Original10031427c..2e4 uses separate multiply/add/sub, strict greater comparison.

Call buffered child with original n and requested output frames. If remainingDiscard>=requested: return0 for this block, subtract requested from discard, contribution0. If 0<discard<requested: retain suffix after discard, visible=requested-discard, contribution=RN64(ideal-Double(discard)), clear discard. Otherwise visible=requested and contribution=ideal.
cumulativeInput+=n; cumulativeVisibleOutput+=visible; cumulativeIdeal=RN64(cumulativeIdeal+contribution). Advance caller output only by visible. These are wrapper counts, not library outputProduced.

buffered_child.input_compaction: Before appending n, if inputCapacity<=inputEnd+n and inputConsumed!=0, move unconsumed [inputConsumed,inputEnd) to the start; inputEnd-=inputConsumed; inputConsumed=0. Format0 branch is selected by original byte jump table, absent from raw pseudocode.
buffered_child.output_compaction: If floor(outputCapacity/2)<=outputEnd+requested and outputRead!=0, move [outputRead,outputEnd) to start; outputEnd-=outputRead; outputRead=0.
buffered_child.call: Append n interleaved frames. For nonnull input and n>0: pass input+inputConsumed*channels, pendingInput+n, &inputUsed, output+outputEnd*channels, requested, &outputProduced to soxr_process. For null input or n==0: pass NULL and clear pendingInput before the call.
buffered_child.update: pendingInput+=n-low32(inputUsed); inputConsumed+=low32(inputUsed); outputEnd+=low32(outputProduced). Copy exactly requested frames from outputRead to caller destination. Then inputEnd+=n and outputRead+=requested; reset inputEnd/inputConsumed when equal, and outputRead/outputEnd when equal.
buffered_child.limits: Native code ignores returned error pointer and does not retry until outputProduced==requested. Independent implementation must distinguish zero-initialized retained storage from produced samples and preserve native buffering, or label an alternative adapter. A fail-closed candidate may reject failed calls/capacity invariants outside successful domain. Do not equate input n, inputUsed, outputProduced and visible output.

rule: For positive final input, build extra copies of that final frame. For null input or zero count, build zero frames instead.

Recurse once with this padding and final=false. Copy returned visible tail; restore cumulativeInput to its pre-padding value. Other counters, including cumulativeVisibleOutput, retain padding processing updates.

remaining=trunc_i64(RN64(Double(savedCumulativeInput)*ratio))-cumulativeVisibleOutput. If remaining>0, call buffered child with NULL input, n=0, requested=remaining, and append that many frames. This last addition is not written to cumulativeVisibleOutput in the inspected tail.
critical_bounds: The native oversized-block split advances x24 while preserving original input in x26. Terminal last-frame address100314474 uses x26+(remainingCount-1)*channels, not the advanced pointer. This handoff therefore limits final caller block<=65408; it makes no assertion that oversized final calls repeat the original overall last frame.
Repeated flush and post-flush reuse are not accepted. A zero-length flush is distinct from a positive block and needs an explicit test.
This wrapper extends with repeated last frame before a NULL library call; directly sending EOF to public SoXR omits that behavior.
